name: Integer Rasterization for Occlusion Masks
definition: A method for calculating occlusion between cells using integer rasterization of boundary polygons onto 2D domains, avoiding continuous analytical clipping.
summary: Integer Rasterization for Occlusion Masks calculates cell occlusion by rasterizing boundary polygons onto 2D domains using deterministic integer arithmetic and exact AABB unions, avoiding floating-point clipping.
